about.author: Author: {author}. Built with AI assistance.
about.components_intro: Voxprint stands on the following open-source projects and models. Thank you to their authors!
about.lgpl: Qt/PySide6 is used under the LGPL-3.0, unmodified and dynamically linked. In the folder-type build you can replace its libraries.
about.notices_missing: The notices file was not found next to the program.
about.privacy: Privacy: use only your own voice (or the voice of someone who explicitly agreed). Recordings and results stay on this computer; the program sends nothing to the internet except downloading models and checking for updates.
about.requirements: Requirements: Windows 11 26H2 is optimal; an NVIDIA graphics card with 16 GB of video memory is recommended.
about.step1: Read a known text aloud and record it (5-15 minutes).
about.step2: Choose the recording and the text file.
about.step3: Voxprint aligns the text to the audio with a neural forced aligner and cuts it into clean fragments - the dataset.
about.step4: Optionally it trains a small voice adapter (LoRA) on your graphics card.
about.step5: Optionally it merges the adapter into a universal model (~4 GB) that works in any app running Qwen3-TTS.
about.title: About Voxprint
about.what: Voxprint turns a recording of your own voice into a voice for Qwen3-TTS. Everything happens on your computer.
err.align_incomplete: The aligner did not process the whole text. Check that the audio and the text belong together.
err.aligner_missing: Speech recognition components not found (qwen-asr / torch). Please reinstall the program.
err.all_dropped: All fragments of the recording turned out too quiet or distorted. Check the microphone and record again.
err.audio_short: The recording is too short (under 10 seconds). At least a few minutes are needed.
err.audio_unreadable: Could not read the audio file. Try another format (WAV or MP3).
err.disk_model: Not enough disk space for the model {short}: about {need} GB needed, {free} GB free.
err.download_failed: Could not download the model {short}. Check your internet connection and try again. You can download the model manually: {url}
err.export_disk: Not enough disk space for the universal model: about {need} GB needed, {free} GB free.
err.export_failed: Could not build the universal model. Details were written to the log.
err.export_no_adapter: No trained voice adapter was found. Train a voice first.
err.fallback_missing: The backup aligner (ctc-forced-aligner) is not installed.
err.hub_missing: The model download component was not found. Please reinstall the program.
err.lang_unsupported: The aligner does not support the language “{language}”.
err.mismatch_extra: The recording has long stretches of speech that are not in the text (at the beginning or the end). Trim the extra part or choose another text.
err.mismatch_length: The recording and the text do not seem to match: the text is much longer or shorter than the recording. Check that you chose the right files and read the whole text.
err.model_partial: The model {short} was not downloaded completely. Please try again.
err.no_clips: The dataset has no suitable clips for training.
err.no_lora_layers: LoRA found no layers to train (incompatible model version).
err.no_metadata: metadata.jsonl not found in the folder. Create the dataset first.
err.no_ref: The voice sample ref.wav was not found.
err.no_sentences: The text has no sentences to align.
err.no_words_found: None of the words from the text could be found in the recording.
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again. If the error repeats, send the developer the log file from the program folder.
err.slice_failed: Could not cut the recording into fragments. Check that the recording and the text match.
err.text_empty: The text file is empty. Choose the file with the text you read.
err.text_no_letters: The text file has no letters or digits. Choose the right file.
err.train_failed: Training stopped because of an error. Details were written to the log.
err.words_mismatch: The aligner's words did not match the text. You may have chosen the wrong text, or the file is damaged.
os.old_build: Voxprint is designed for Windows 11 26H2 (build {min}+). You have build {build}: the program may not work correctly. Please update Windows.
os.unsupported: Voxprint is designed for Windows 11 (26H2). Problems are possible on this system.

Use only your own voice (or the voice of a person who has given explicit consent).

Recordings, text and the finished voice are stored only on your computer; the program sends nothing to the internet except downloading models and checking for updates.

upd.download_failed: Could not download the updates; the previous version was kept.
upd.no_net_check: No internet connection - the update check was skipped.
upd.no_net_restore: No internet connection - could not restore the verified versions.
upd.no_python: Package update skipped: Python was not found on this computer.
upd.restart: Restart the program to start using the updates.
upd.rolled_back: The update failed the compatibility check - the previous version was kept.
upd.up_to_date: Everything is already up to date.
warn.adam8_unavailable: The 8-bit optimizer is unavailable, using the regular one (slightly more memory is needed).
warn.align_inexact: Some words were aligned inexactly; the slicing quality may be slightly lower.
warn.audio_short_2min: The recording is under 2 minutes: 5-15 minutes is better for a good voice.
warn.chars_unlabeled: {left} characters at the end of the text were not aligned.
warn.few_segments: There are few fragments (under 20): the voice may turn out inaccurate. Recording 10-15 minutes is better.
warn.loss_flat: The training loss barely decreased - the voice may not sound like yours.
warn.loss_low: The final training loss is low ({loss} < {threshold}): the voice may have turned to “mush” or the speech may not stop. If it sounds bad, record more text and try again.
warn.low_vram: There is not much video memory: training will be slower than usual.
warn.no_gpu: No NVIDIA graphics card is being used: training will run on the processor and take many hours. A NVIDIA graphics card is needed for a fast result.
warn.no_ref_5_10: No 5-10 s fragment was found for the voice sample; the longest one was used.
warn.oom_8bit: The memory-saving optimizer was turned on because memory ran out.
warn.oom_small: A lighter model was chosen because memory ran out.
warn.quality_dropped: Fragments automatically dropped for poor sound: {n}.
warn.quality_snr_off: The recording has an even volume: the noise check was turned off.
warn.skipped_long: Clips skipped for being too long: {n}.
warn.slice_dropped: {n} fragments skipped (too short/long); this is normal at the end of a recording.
warn.text_enc_unknown: Could not determine the text encoding exactly; some characters may be garbled.
warn.text_not_utf8: The text file is not UTF-8 (looks like {enc}). I read it, but it is better to save the text as UTF-8 to avoid errors.
warn.text_utf16: The text file is UTF-16. Saving it as UTF-8 is recommended.
warn.very_low_vram: Video memory is low: a lighter model is used, voice quality may be lower.
